WITH matched AS (
  SELECT ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  WHERE ab.peercorr >= 0.149
    AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
), counts AS (
  SELECT translink, ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS matched_count
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY translink, ordertypedist
)
SELECT
  translink,
  ordertypedist,
  matched_count,
  CAST(matched_count AS REAL) / SUM(matched_count) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS fraction_of_type_total
FROM counts
ORDER BY fraction_of_type_total DESC
LIMIT 10;
